name: Tembisa
scopeLimits: 231 valid, distinct Ekurhuleni municipal stand references verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Tembisa WUP locator. GIS_KEY supplies native identity; every source component is retained and administrative references must agree. Complete object-ID manifests, three-row paging of the 45-row viewport and its full component refresh (fifteen geometry pages each), all 231 fresh identity reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:32735 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Stand S850000000000900000 retains eight disjoint components totalling about 1.963 km²; matching township/property/portion/SG references support its shared source identity. It is not excluded by size, flattened, clipped or repaired. Coverage, title, survey accuracy and identity beyond this bounded evidence are unverified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: City of Ekurhuleni public GIS portal exposes a Property Data > Stands map layer to public users; municipal GIS Division says it maintains property data and municipal cadastre. Polygon service returned a stand intersecting the Tembisa WUP locator.
remainingUncertainty: Municipality-wide completeness, legal title and survey accuracy beyond this bounded evidence remain unverified.
nextStep: Inspect the enabled local parcel map and normal parcel selection.

executedQueries.executionMethod: Separate native/English-language search and first-party page review; no login, owner, address, or property query.

officialSources.observation: Official public City GIS portal supports map/data viewing and lists Property Data > Stands.
ArcGIS Server 11.3; layer 1 Stands is polygon geometry with full city extent, GeoJSON query/paging support and maxRecordCount 500000. Safe ID fields used; other attributes not requested.
Municipal GIS Division says it manages spatial property data and maintains municipal cadastre.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Existing ArcGIS adapter passed thirteen bounded cells, forced 3-row paging, exact-ID re-reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding. Returned 23 distinct canonical polygons in 139 requests; WUP point intersects a stand.

qualitySummary.reviewNote: One eight-part merged parcel has a large 1.96 km² area; valid and disjoint in the checked sample but remains an outlier for review.

verifiedParcelResponse.note: Twenty-three full polygons from thirteen bounded cells passed adapter checks. Citywide completeness is not claimed. Independent GEOS found all valid, no duplicates/positive-area overlaps above 0.01 m². One eight-part feature has a 1.96 km² area outlier.
